name: Agile Project Selection
excerpt: Agile project selection allows quick adaptation to changing environments.
notes:
Agile project selection refers to the ability to move and pivot quickly, responding to changing environments. It involves continuously exploring the needs of customers and stakeholders and providing frequent feedback and updates to the team direction.
